evidence: Authored for this product: every template CHANGE_ME is replaced with HireOps-specific content (task.toml:5-15 name turing/hireops-recruiting-operations, description, difficulty_explanation, arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations'); instruction.md is a first-person request from a recruiting team (board + candidate conversations + candidate sign-in) and hireops_rules.md gives product-specific rules (six stages incl. Rejected-with-remembered-origin, per-job interview places 1-50, hiring-manager late-stage scope, per-card version 409, optimistic move with focus kept, bulk move ordering, single-level undo with invalidation, 30-message paging, per-person unread, candidate/observer 'seen' semantics, per-person-per-browser drafts surviving session end, candidate wording table). Criterion ids are product-prefixed (hro_*), 43 functional + 5 polish + 5 visual + 2 gates, and prompts/app_context name only HireOps accounts (@hireops.example / @candidates.example), jobs and the seeded 120-message Noor Haddad conversation. Grep of the frozen task for sibling names/concepts (Pellmoor, Threadline, TorqueBay, Colderwater, Ridgeline, BazaarBridge, Patchpad, GridForge, MedLedger, vacancy, funnel, panel member, webhook, channel, CHANGE_ME) found only a BroadcastChannel API call in solution/public/js/app.js:139 - no residue. Not a nouns-swapped clone: the nearest same-domain sibling, pellmoor-job-pipeline, shares the recruiting domain and some generic rule themes (no stage skipping, capacity, atomic batch, stale 409), but its flows are different - panel scoring with versioned assessments, offer/hired opening reservations, reviewed batch-offer previews, actor-scoped durable retry receipts and a d3 funnel from stage history, on a TypeScript/d3/esbuild stack with only the hiring manager moving cards. HireOps has none of those; it instead grades a shared hand-ordered kanban, interview-place limits, undo, live board without disturbing typing/focus, staff-candidate messaging with paging/unread/seen/drafts, and a candidate portal with data confinement. The golden is plain JS (solution/app/src/index.js 425 lines, public/js/board.js, threads.js) with no Pellmoor files or concepts (only CSS class 'panel' and a 'receipt' seen-label match). threadline-chat overlaps only on generic chat mechanics (unread, load older without losing place) inside a channel/thread/reaction/webhook product. Broken-app / alternative probe: a Pellmoor-style app renamed to HireOps would fail most HireOps criteria (no undo, no conversations, no candidate portal), and the HireOps criteria do not grade Pellmoor-only artefacts, so the rubric itself is task-specific. Limitation (recorded, not a defect): no written suite 'domain plan' document exists in the workspace; fit is judged from the assignment provenance ('Adapted from the supplied HireOps task', task.toml:14) and a distinct arena_slice. Two recruiting-domain tasks coexist in projects/; if the client's slice plan forbids that, it is an assignment decision, not an authoring defect of this candidate. This row requires no runtime measurement.
